_comment: Offline fallback for the NCR-0412 lesson draft (PLAN 7.3). Used only when the forced Claude tool call is unavailable or its answer fails validation. Order matters: the writer assigns L1, L2, F1 in this order.

lessons.title: Spring pass plus lower radial engagement clears bore taper
lessons.content: Bore taper on Ti-6Al-4V housings cleared when introducing a spring pass with 0.05 mm radial depth of cut.
lessons.action: Add a finishing spring pass with 0.05 mm radial depth of cut on Ø32H7 titanium finish boring

lessons.title: Raise coolant concentration for Inconel 718 finish boring
lessons.content: Chatter on Inconel 718 bores cleared when coolant concentration rose from 8% to 10%.
lessons.action: Raise coolant concentration to 10% before finish boring Inconel 718 bores

lessons.title: Feed reduction alone fails to correct bore taper on Ti-6Al-4V
lessons.content: Reducing feed rate from 0.08 mm/rev to 0.04 mm/rev on the finish boring trial caused tool rubbing and worsened the bore taper.
lessons.action: Do not attempt feed reduction alone on Ø32H7 titanium finish boring; it worsens bore taper and drives the bore out of tolerance
